scope: Validation-only isolated real-uniform public CKKS codec candidate; no production integration, encrypted bootstrap timing, accelerator transfer timing, or model-performance claim
guarded_envelope: One-dimensional real-uniform finite numeric vector; power-of-two slot count dividing N/2
Power-of-two cyclotomic order; compatible positive uint31 moduli with accepted roots
Finite positive binary64 scale, default NumPy floating error configuration, NSD exactly integer1 or2
Default signed bound and integer word bits1 through61; rounded coefficient within centered half interval
Finite FFT intermediates: abs(constant)<=maxfloat/slot_count; finite scaled coefficient
Nonzero scaled magnitudes requiring logc<0 delegate to preserve ScalingFactorTooSmall; exact underflow to zero retains ordinary zero encoding
fallback: All unsupported vector/parameter/error-policy settings delegate to unchanged _ckks_encode_array; warning and exception parity checked. Python input iterators and unusual scalar/container types are not consumed by the fast path.
mathematical_basis: For a real uniform vector, each FFT difference is exactly zero and each nonzero sum is a power-of-two scaling; guarded intermediates stay finite. Division by the power-of-two slot count returns the same binary64 constant. Only coefficient0 is nonzero, so its standard-residue NTT image is uniform in each modulus. The candidate uses the same log2/ceil, nearest_int, log_approx restoration and integer noise-scale multiplier as the ordinary codec.

timing.scope: Warm public NTT tables; fully materialized host arrays; excludes transfer and client encryption
timing.conversion_scope: Warm CPU JAX ndarray conversion; may share host buffers, not a TPU transfer measurement

development_notes: Initial independent-oracle harness used full16 slots for sparse extreme values, which could overflow a reference FFT that the sparse candidate did not use; corrected to preserve slot count.
The independent scalar reference expects normalized complex values; boolean/raw NumPy inputs were normalized as in the production codec before comparison.
Candidate conservatively delegates every nondefault NumPy floating error mode to preserve caller-selected warnings and exceptions.
Earlier48-case scalar experiment and already-landed ndarray/list conversion patch are separate evidence; these timings do not include those historical runs.
